label: How often do you take time for...
rows: Fun activities: engage in a hobby, gardening for fun, arts and crafts, listening to music, etc
Exercise: hiking, running, walking, going to the gym, doing yoga, swimming, cycling, etc
Games: playing group sports, playing board games, card games, puzzles, etc.
Connecting: calling friends or family members, going out with friends, connecting with individuals on social media, etc.
Silliness: deliberately engaging in playful activities that are just for the fun of it and bring out your inner 7-year old
Self-improvement: read or listen to personal development
Spiritual: get out in nature, meet with people from your belief group, meditate, etc

label: How often do you spend time on...
rows: Venting: calling a friend/family member to gripe or gossip
Distractions: eat, watch TV, play video games, etc
Chores: laundry, cleaning, organizing, yard work, etc.
